answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with periodic memory-hard proof-of-work using Argon2id bound to each public key. Each round, an agent hashes its key and a public beacon to find a target nonce, stemming a tide of bots chasing fee nectar; verifiers check the proof in one pass. Unlike permits carved in jade, tickets expire each round, imposing a verifiable memory-time cost per identity. However, adversaries using rented cloud RAM or botnets can still sustain extra accounts.
